reviews.title: Would be fun, but…
reviews.text:
I’d love to rate this game higher, but with the number, frequency, and length of the ads, it’s nearly unplayable.

I tried to play for an hour last night. 45 minutes of that time went to watching ads. 

I get that developers need ad revenue, but a 3-minute unskippable ad after each level is a little ridiculous, especially when the levels don’t even take that long. 

Uninstalling. Talk to your marketers.

reviews.title: Hate timed games!!
reviews.text:
I don’t typically play these kinds of games but tried it because I get paid through Best Play. One of my BP goals was to use a ‘level up power up’. Not sure what that is exactly. I used a boost I had but apparently that isn’t it. 

Also I can only drag the hole so fast so to have a timed game is incredibly frustrating. I have to blindly collect so many of certain objects having no idea what direction to go. Just tried a lev 3 times and got no where close to all of them. Yeah.. sooo much fun 👎😒

Edit: OH and I forgot!.. lots of interruptions in the game. Ads.. options for MORE ads if you want diamonds .. #1 pet peeve in a game is not being able to just play a single lev without interruptions. Make me watch more ads in between levels l! I don’t care!.. just don’t bug me in the middle of a level!!
